title: Spring Core & Spring Boot
intro: Spring Boot is the default backend framework for Java fullstack development, and freshers are expected to know it well enough to bootstrap a REST API on their first week. This module covers the IoC container, dependency injection, auto-configuration magic, and the operational features like Actuator and profiles that make Spring Boot production-ready. Interviewers at every company — from startups to MNCs — ask at least 5–10 Spring Core questions in a fresher round.
